title: bidens puberula
intro: Bidens puberula, commonly known as rough beggartick or hairy beggar lice, is a perennial plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae) that is native to North America. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, inflammation, and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits. Bidens puberula is known to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its medicinal value. The bioactive constituents of Bidens puberula include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
